newsitem.title: USA: Dole says Powell can have any cabinet job he wants.
newsitem.headline: Dole says Powell can have any cabinet job he wants.

text.p: Republican presidential candidate Bob Dole said retired U.S. General Colin Powell could have "any place he wanted" in the cabinet if Dole is elected, according to an interview released by ABC-TV Friday.
Asked by interviewer Barbara Walters if Powell, the former chairman of the military Joint Chiefs of Staff, would have a place in his cabinet, Dole answered, "Any place he wanted."
"Really any place he wants?" Walters queried.
"Well ... I'd almost give him mine," Dole quipped.
The interview took place this week, an ABC official said. The full interview will air on ABC's "20/20" programme at 10 p.m. EDT Friday.
After addressing the Republican National Convention in San Diego last month, Powell said he was content with private life but did not rule out future public office.
Powell said he would consider a cabinet position if Dole won.
"I expect there will be a Dole administration and I would consider anything the president asks me to do," the retired four-star general said in a post-convention interview with CBS.
